# Cargo workspace notices

These are upstream license documents, not GPLv3 project source. The manifest
pins the source repository commit, source URL, package version and document
SHA-256. Source-package checksums come from Cargo's verified crate metadata.

Some upstream crates omit the workspace license from their published package.
Those documents were retrieved from the exact recorded source commit. Where
the crate declares a standard license but publishes no standalone license file,
its original Cargo declaration, source-header copyright notices where supplied,
and the standard license text are retained. The manifest labels this treatment;
it does not invent absent authorship or copyright years.

The checker verifies these documents before adding them to a release inventory.
The files keep their upstream terms and must not be relabeled as GPLv3.
